reports.title: Redwire Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results, Expands Backlog, Achieves Record Gross Margins

guidance.heading: 2026 Forecast
section: •For the full year ended December 31, 2026, Redwire reaffirms that it is forecasting revenues of $450 million to $500 million.

“During the third quarter of 2026, Redwire achieved record gross margins of 32.3%, driven by year-over-year and sequential improvement from both our Space and Defense Tech segments. With a focus on delivering proven capabilities to our customers at scale, we continued to invest in innovation and manufacturing capacity,” said Chris Edmunds, Chief Financial Officer of Redwire. “With $323.1 million of recorded revenue during the first nine months of 2026 supported by a record $619.7 million in Backlog4 and $46.8 million of work in process and finished goods inventory, we again reaffirm our 2026 revenue forecast.”
